[AIM]: Add the shared EXIT/SEND action adapter for the AIM button

Hosts pick EXIT / SEND from the state that already shows the submit
button, so the button fires one event with the original keyboard or
mouse event; hosts can drop the cancel icon (X), and no host uses
32px height.

bluetooth: Stop discovery when advertisement clients are cleared

ClearAdvertisementClients() dropped the scanning and watch
advertisements clients on tab hide or focus loss without releasing the
underlying discovery sessions, so the platform (BlueZ) scan stayed
active for the lifetime of the tab; call MaybeStopDiscovery() so the
session is released together with its last client.

ServiceWorker: Flush decoder when loading installed scripts

ServiceWorkerInstalledScriptsManager::GetScriptData() decodes the
installed script body using TextResourceDecoder::Decode(), but omitted
calling decoder->Flush().

Because TextResourceDecoder buffers up to 3 bytes for BOM detection
and TextCodec buffers incomplete multi-byte sequences, omitting Flush()
causes scripts smaller than 3 bytes to decode into empty strings, and
incomplete multi-byte sequences at EOF to drop their trailing
replacement characters (U+FFFD).

This diverged from WorkerClassicScriptLoader::DidFinishLoading(), which
always flushes the decoder upon completing the initial network load.
This CL calls decoder->Flush() at the end of GetScriptData() and appends
any remaining flushed text, ensuring consistent decoded source text
between network and installed script loads.

Increase browser_tests shards on win-asan from 120 to 140

Even after disabling WebUIOmniboxPopup (https://crrev.com/c/8535352) and
default renderer prewarming in InProcessBrowserTest
(https://crrev.com/c/8542233) on win-asan, browser_tests shard durations
remain close enough to the 60m timeout limit that slower shards still
time out.

Increase the number of shards from 120 to 140 to provide additional
runtime headroom and prevent shard timeouts.

[ChoMenu GlowUp] Keep mnemonics in row style menu items and their submenus

This CL uses the hooks added in the parent CL 8531890. BrowserActions
sets actions::kMnemonicTextKey on the row menu items. The value is the
same string (only the '...' were removed using
chrome::GetMnemonicTitleText()). GetText() was not changed, so toolbar
buttons, tooltips and search are not affected.

Also, for rows that have text override, ActionAppMenu applies it with
MenuItemView::SetTitleOverride(). This way whenever an action is updated
its row menu item keeps its mnemonic.

Screenshot of change:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1n_-IiYnH5bBmTjCFILFFgoWBNgiVIplb/view?usp=sharing

ServiceWorker: Respect encoding for top-level worker scripts

Plumb the resolved TextEncoding of top-level classic worker scripts from
WorkerClassicScriptLoader and InstalledScriptsManager::ScriptData
through to ServiceWorkerScriptCachedMetadataHandler::Encoding().

This ensures that the script encoding is taken into account when
generating and matching V8 code cache for service worker scripts.
Guarded by the new runtime-enabled feature.

See the bug for details.

[NTP Aurora V2] Align beside-MVT AI Mode card with MVT tiles and hide tile icon backgrounds

This CL updates the styling and alignment of the AI Mode card and Most
Visited Tiles when the beside-MVT layout (NTP Aurora V2) is enabled:

- Vertical Alignment: Aligns the top and bottom paddings of the
  beside-MVT AI Mode card with the MVT container so the AI Mode icon
  and label line up with the MVT tiles across both default and Aurora
  V1 padding styles.

- Two-Line Title Wrapping: Allows the beside-MVT AI Mode button label
  to wrap up to 2 lines with centered horizontal gravity when large
  font sizes are used, matching the "Add new" MVT button behavior, and
  keeps both cards at matching heights.

- Remove Circular Tile Backgrounds when the beside-MVT module is
  enabled.

Screenshots: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1bMRVyyqOd0-cAmyTbL9IhKNU9uSvDdpdCngSzSXIHnk/edit?tab=t.0#bookmark=id.7r569vl0hwq7

LHS: Update --ntp-search-box-width's break points to base on RHS width

Before, the break points relied on @media min-width, which refers to the
window width. With LHS taking up space (follow-up CL), these numbers
will no longer be accurate. This change updated the break point rules to
reference the RHS width instead.

Remove exit time destructor in WaylandDataDeviceBase

Change the return type of WaylandDataDeviceBase::GetAvailableMimeTypes()
to a span, instead of exposing the underlying container type by
const-ref. Then if the underlying container is not available,
GetAvailableMimeTypes() can just return an empty span, instead of being
forced to instantiate an empty vector which comes with an exit time
destructor. Then change the GetAvailableMimeTypes() to copy the return
value appropriately.

[actor] Support credit_card_opaque_token in AttemptFormFillingTool

When incoming AttemptFormFillingAction contains a non-empty
credit_card_opaque_token:
- AttemptFormFillingTool::Invoke asynchronously retrieves a suggestion
  via ActorFormFillingService::RetrieveSuggestionForCreditCardOpaqueToken.
- Upon completion, AttemptFormFillingTool::DirectlyFillSuggestions directly
  fills the suggestion into the form sections, skipping the dialog that asks
  the user to select a suggestion.
- Rejects actions that combine a credit_card_opaque_token with address
  requests across proto conversion and tool invocation (Desktop and iOS)
  with kArgumentsInvalid.
- Handles retrieval errors and empty suggestions gracefully by returning
  kFormFillingNoSuggestionsAvailable.
- Adds unit tests and browser tests for Desktop and iOS.

LHS: Move voice search dialog into #rhsContent

In order to accommodate LHS, we put the existing #content of NTP into a
RHS div in crrev.com/c/8542238. In the next crrev.com/c/8544436, we'll
update the @media (min-width) queries in NTP app.css to @container
rhsContent (mid-width) instead, where we overwrite css variables that
the voice search dialog depends on. But because #voiceSearchDialog sits
outside of #rhsContent right now, it won't inherit the overwrites.

As a fix, this change moves #voiceSearchDialog into #rhsContent.

This change should have no behavior change:
- The dialog is opened with showModal(), so it renders in the top layer and its DOM position doesn't affect stacking or layout.
- It's added to COMPOSEBOX_INERT_ALLOWLIST so that it isn't made inert along with the other direct children of #rhsContent while the composebox is open.

Decisions API: Route AIManager to the language model (Gemma 4) backend

Lets AIManager create AILanguageModelDecisionModel (crrev.com/c/8500743),
the only Decisions API backend for now.

- Uses the Prompt API's foundation model and use case resolution
  (PromptApiFeatureConfig via the manifest broker), reusing the existing
  Gemma 4 delivery.
- Requires OnDeviceModelForceCpuBackend as a temporary workaround for
  GPU backend scoring issues (crbug.com/571218294); otherwise
  CanCreateDecisionModel() reports kUnavailableFeatureNotEnabled.
- chrome://flags#decisions-api also enables the manifest broker, Gemma 4
  and OnDeviceModelForceCpuBackend, which affect all built-in AI APIs.

Decisions API: Add language model (Gemma 4) backend

Adds AILanguageModelDecisionModel, a blink.mojom.AIDecisionModel that
scores options using the Prompt API's on-device foundation model
(e.g. Gemma 4) and the shared schema compiler (crrev.com/c/8519223).
Not wired up to AIManager yet.

- DecisionModelPromptBuilder builds the system, input, and per-question
  prompts, mapping each option to a distinct letter key (A, B, ...) for
  single-token Session::Score() evaluation.
- create() checks that the system prompt plus each question fit within
  the token quota (failing with kInitialInputTooLarge otherwise).
- decide() checks that the input fits (kErrorInputTooLarge), appends the
  system prompt and input once to a fresh session, and scores each
  question and option on cloned session states before normalizing via
  DecodeResult().
- Serializes decide() calls in order at the page's current priority, and
  uses the Prompt API's ModelClient, token limit, and health reporting.

Scale Customize Chrome WebUI text with OS font size on Android

Set `text-size-adjust: calc(100% * env(preferred-text-scale))` on `body`
in `customize_chrome.html` so that text in the Customize Chrome side
panel scales with the Android system Font size accessibility setting
while preserving px layout dimensions.

Also update `segmented_button_option.css` to hide the Light/Dark/Device
icons via `@container (max-width: calc(24px + 6ch))` (moving `font-size:
12px; font-weight: 500` onto the `#button` size container) so the icons
are dropped both when the side panel is narrow and when
`text-size-adjust` boosts the text to the point where "Device" would
truncate.

See go/customize-chrome-resizing-validation for some screenshots
(googler only)

Customize Chrome: Make side panel resize horizontally

On Android the side panel WebContents can be 400px (wide), 348px
(narrow), or as little as 200px wide (shrink-to-fit). On desktop the
panel defaults to 360px but can be dragged wider.

Make the Customize Chrome side panel adapt to these widths:
* Scale the inline padding (--sp-card-inline-padding) linearly from
  16px at >=360px down to 8px at 200px, and derive the grid gap from it
  (8px -> 4px). All hardcoded 16/32/48px inline paddings and margins now
  reference these variables, so desktop at >=360px is unchanged.
* Keep color tiles square and scale them with the grid; make the color
  circle padding a percentage so the circle scales with its tile.
* Hide the segmented button icons via a container query when there is
  not enough room for icon + label.
* Cap content at 400px (Android's widest) and keep it start-aligned when
  the desktop panel is dragged wider than that.

See go/customize-chrome-resizing-validation for some screenshots
(googler only)

[crubit] Enable `assume_lifetimes` by default in `rust_api_from_cpp`.

Without lifetime annotations, Crubit binds C++ references (including
`this`) as raw pointers, which makes most methods `unsafe` to call from
Rust.  Crubit's `assume_lifetimes` feature applies Rust's lifetime
elision rules instead (e.g. `this` becomes `&self`).

This CL:

* Adds `assume_lifetimes` to the Crubit features enabled for all
  `rust_api_from_cpp` targets.
* Adds `//build/rust/crubit:cref` for Rust code that uses `CRef` or
  `CMut` (the types of C++ references returned from the bindings).
* Adds a short "References and lifetimes" section to
  `docs/rust/crubit/rust_api_from_cpp.md`.  The section links to
  Crubit's docs and covers Chromium-specific details.
* Adds tests for elided and for explicit lifetimes.

IcuBridge migration: //c/autofill/c/b/data_model/autofill_ai/

Remove usages of ICU date formatter. This is part of the effort to
migrate direct usages of ICU to use IcuBridge so we can migrate
components one by one to ICU4x.

The new standard implemented by ICU4x does not support free pattern
strings as an input for date-time formatting, that is why we are making
the effort to remove all usages of direct ICU4C formatter in-favor of
IcuBridge which is going to handle the migration between them.

[Churned-Users] Pass AccountInfo to UI delegate and centralize metric logging

Previously, PaymentsChurnedUsersUiDelegateDesktop retrieved
IdentityManager and PaymentsDataManager, checked for an extended account
info, and logged
Autofill.PaymentsChurnedUsersUi.ShowResult.NoAccountInfoPresent if
empty. Because this logic is platform-agnostic, running it in the UI
delegate meant it only executed on Desktop and was bypassed on Clank
(Android).

This CL centralizes the account info retrieval and metric logging in
PaymentsChurnedUsersManager::OnFieldTypesDetermined:
- If extended AccountInfo is empty, logs kNoAccountInfoPresent and exits early.
- Otherwise, passes the retrieved AccountInfo to
PaymentsChurnedUsersUiDelegate::ShowPaymentsChurnedUsersUI(AccountInfo,
...).
- Updates PaymentsChurnedUsersUiDelegate implementations on Desktop and Android to accept AccountInfo.
- Updates unit tests and browser tests accordingly.

Testing screenshot:
- https://screenshot-v2.corp.google.com/63jYXZAPdwrgmV3
- See histogram shows #7 kNoAccountInfoPresent
(https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:components/autofill/core/browser/payments/payments_churned_users_metrics.h;l=27)
with dash, meaning that kNoAccountInfoPresent is triggered
- The bottomsheet also doesn't appear in the testing webpage and #0 kShown
(https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:components/autofill/core/browser/payments/payments_churned_users_metrics.h;l=20)
is not triggered.

4fe9555a804d85de46619967c1a7b6a2a24ca0a6 [ diff ] 
Ensure GatherObservations references remain safe to use

In ResizeObserver::GatherObservations(), ObservationSizeOutOfSync() and
TargetDepth() can trigger a synchronous update which adds to
`observations_` and reallocates its backing buffer. Using `auto&` bound
a `const WeakMember<ResizeObservation>&` directly into that buffer,
which was unsafe to use if the buffer moved. Using `ResizeObservation*`
instead copies the pointer and is valid even if `observations_`
reallocates.

351d1469b0b9891a9e70c45d4bc1c75691a8058f [ diff ] 
[crd host][mac] Check caller UID when brokering host services

AgentProcessBroker runs as root and forwards ChromotingHostServices
receivers to the active agent process. It only validated the caller's
code signature, so a signed helper running as one user could bind the
session services of another user's active agent.

Record each agent's real UID when it registers, and reject
BindChromotingHostServices() when the caller's real UID does not match
the active agent's UID. This matches the per-user isolation that Linux
(require_same_peer_user) and Windows (session ID check) already have.

Replace IsRootProcessGetter with ProcessUidGetter so tests can fake
both root-ness and per-user identity through the same seam.

[WebUI NTP on AL] Enable new_tab_page_browsertest on Android

Enable new_tab_page_browsertest.cc and composebox_test_files on Android
Desktop when enable_webui_ntp is true.

- Move new_tab_page_browsertest.cc from !is_android to enable_webui_ntp
  in chrome/test/data/webui/BUILD.gn, and add a direct dep on
  composebox/variations. The test already includes
  composebox_fieldtrial.h, and on Android nothing else provides that
  header through public deps, so gn check fails without it.
- Include composebox_test_files unconditionally and guard Smart Tab
  Sharing references with <if expr="not is_android">, since its
  searchbox.mojom methods are [EnableIfNot=is_android].
- Add installMetricsReporterMock() in realbox_test.ts so suites with
  reportMetrics set don't call the unmocked PageMetricsHost.
- Enable kNtpCustomizeWebUiAndroid in NewTabPageBrowserTest on Android.
- On Android, remove the 5s wall-clock deadline from
  waitForAddFileCallCount. Pasted files are uploaded one at a time, and
  each image upload makes a sync IPC to the browser UI thread
  (URL.createObjectURL). On the Android emulator that thread can stall
  for seconds while the soft keyboard animates, so
  ComposeboxUploadPasteTest could miss the deadline. On Android the
  helper now waits for the calls and asserts the exact count; the C++
  test timeout still catches real hangs. Desktop keeps the deadline.
- In the RealboxSearchbox tab picker test, assert right after
  handleFuseboxAction() resolves. It opens the real context menu, and
  yielding first lets an OS-generated window blur or resize close the
  menu and reset shareTabsFlyoutOpen.
- In the RealboxSearchbox entity image test, let the real image request
  settle before mocking its load. Browser tests have no external
  network access, so the request fails, and its error event could land
  after the mocked load and bring back the placeholder color.
- Disable Logo, VoiceSearchCoherence, InvariantChecks (b:565815572) and
  ComposeboxContextMenu (b:565815899) on Android.
- Since kNtpOneGoogleBar is disabled by default on Android, disable
  OgbThemingRemoveScrim and OgbScrim and skip the OGB tests in Theming
  there (b:571327206).
- Remove the unused history_clusters include.

[iOS] Move ForceDismissFloaty() triggers to GeminiContainerMediator

Move ForceDismissFloaty() triggers (OnWillEnterIncognito(),
OnPrimaryAccountChanged(), and OnIdentityManagerShutdown()) from
GeminiBrowserAgent to GeminiContainerMediator.

When IsIOSGeminiBottomSheetMigrationEnabled() is enabled,
GeminiContainerMediator dismisses the Gemini flow using Gemini
commands. Otherwise, it delegates to ForceDismissFloaty() in
GeminiBrowserAgent.

[SideUi] Compare SideUiShowability IDs as sets (3/5)

Make SideUiShowability hold sets of IDs instead of lists.
-Previously, SideUiShowability#equals compared lists, so the order the
 IDs were added in mattered. Since paused containers are now laid out
 first, pausing or resuming a container could reorder the IDs and
 notify SideUiObservers of a showability change when nothing changed.
-The previous CL worked around this by sorting the IDs.
-Now, the IDs are sets, so their order doesn't matter, and the sort is
 removed. Consumers only check whether an ID is (un)showable.

78005cd1d1f9e3f97b906be2e95d493ad41a4560 [ diff ] 
[SideUi] Add API to pause Side UI updates (2/5)

Add SideUiCoordinator#pauseSideUiUpdates and #resumeSideUiUpdates.
-Previously, any Side UI update could resize, re-position or detach a
 container at any time. This breaks e.g. a tab drag that started from
 the vertical tabs rail if the rail changes mid-drag.
-Now, a paused container keeps the size it had when it was paused,
 and keeps reserving that width, so the web contents and the other
 containers lay out around it. Other containers are laid out as if it
 had the highest priority, so they may be auto-closed to make room for
 it. It isn't asked for its showable size or whether it has content to
 show while paused.
-A paused container gets no update or auto-close/restore callbacks.
 Resuming runs one non-animated update (UpdateReason#UPDATES_RESUMED)
 that applies the latest state, and may auto-close or auto-restore the
 resumed container.
-Pausing ends any in-progress animation first. It isn't ref-counted,
 and unregistering a paused container resumes it first.

[Omnibox] Truncate Fusebox popup row text after 2 lines

Per the Plus Menu Design Iteration UX spec, Fusebox (+) popup row
labels should wrap to at most 2 lines and end with an ellipsis instead
of growing without limit at large font sizes or with long
translations.

* Sets maxLines=2 and ellipsize=end on @id/action_text in
  fusebox_list_item.xml. This covers both static rows inflated from
  XML and dynamically bound rows; recent-tab rows keep their existing
  1-line override in FuseboxViewBinder.
* Removes android:singleLine from Fusebox.PopupMenu.Item. The style is
  applied to the row's LinearLayout root, which ignores TextView
  attributes, so it was a misleading no-op.
* Adds FuseboxViewBinderUnitTest#listItems_truncateAfterTwoLines.

[Glic] Fix stale recreation state override clobbering expanded Show

When an Actor task tab is detached into BackgroundTabPool (e.g. when
Chrome is backgrounded), GlicSidePanelCoordinatorAndroid::OnTabWillDetach
and OnTabWillDeactivate call SaveStateBeforeDeactivation(), which saves
initial_state_override_for_activity_recreation_ = kPeeked if the Glic
bottom sheet was in peek mode.

When the user subsequently taps an Actor notification and the live
background tab is restored into the TabModel before
TabBottomSheetManagerImpl finishes initializing on the window
(!tab_bottom_sheet_bridge_->IsManagerReady()):
1. OnTabDidActivate calls Show(kPeeked), deferring to
   pending_show_options_.
2. GlicKeyedService.maybeInvokeGlic calls Show(kExpanded), updating
   pending_show_options_->initial_state to kExpanded.
3. When OnManagerInitialized fires, it unconditionally overwrites
   pending_show_options_->initial_state (kExpanded) with the stale
   initial_state_override_for_activity_recreation_ (kPeeked). Opening
   the sheet in kPeeked immediately transitions the coordinator to
   State::kPeek, which causes GlicSidePanelUi::SidePanelStateChanged to
   deactivate and close the active conversation embedder.

Fix this by:
- Clearing initial_state_override_for_activity_recreation_ when Show()
  is called with InitialState::kExpanded, and once Show() completes.
- Preserving InitialState::kExpanded in pending_show_options_ if a
  subsequent Show(kPeeked) is called while waiting for manager
  initialization.

fd24ed6bda13731e6256e2128637f8959d8593f4 [ diff ] 
Match cross-device themes by OsType, FormFactor, and DataType

Theme sync services on Desktop, iOS, and Android upload a single theme
entity per platform using fixed client tags ("current_theme",
"current_theme_ios", "android_theme_tag") rather than per-device GUID
client tags. As a result, CrossDeviceThemeTracker::ResolveDeviceInfo
previously failed to match any DeviceInfo when hashing device->guid(),
leaving theme_info.guid empty and causing GetThemeForDeviceGuid to
return nullptr for non-empty device GUIDs.

Since themes are synced per platform rather than per device, replace
GetBestMatchDeviceGuid and GetThemeForDeviceGuid with
GetBestMatchDeviceOsTypeAndFormFactor and
GetThemeForOsTypeAndFormFactor, matching synced themes by platform
DataType via OsTypeToDataType(os_type, form_factor). Store
syncer::DataType directly in DeviceThemeInfo instead of DeviceInfo
fields, and remove unused DeviceInfoTracker observation,
ResolveDeviceInfo, and per-device fields (guid, device_name,
form_factor, os_type) from CrossDeviceThemeTracker and DeviceThemeInfo.

[Gamepad] Add thread-safety guards to FakeIGamepadStatics

FakeIGamepadStatics is accessed from multiple threads (test thread,
ThreadPool sequences, and the gamepad polling thread) without
synchronization. Add a base::Lock guarding its shared state via
GUARDED_BY(), and copy event handlers under the lock before
invoking them, since Invoke() may run arbitrary code and must not
be called while the lock is held.

[glic] Start benchmark: remove harness artifacts from the cold number

The default HTTP/1 EmbeddedTestServer closes the connection after every
response, so each guest script fetch paid a TCP+TLS handshake;
production serves the client over one HTTP/2 connection. The test client
also imported WebClientMode as a value, pulling the 46 KB generated API
into a three-deep import waterfall that production never fetches. And a
fresh test browser paid network-service initialization on the first
open.

Serve the guest from an H2 server (new
GlicBrowserTestMixin::set_glic_https_test_server() hook; other fixtures
are unchanged), make the client's API imports type-only with
modulepreload for the remaining two files, and warm the network service
with one navigation to a separate origin before the timer. The guest
origin is left cold on purpose: Chrome does not preconnect for Glic, so
its DNS/TCP/TLS is real cold-open cost. Also wait for a ready spare
renderer before timing, log nav/resource timing per iteration, and have
run_glic_start_benchmark.py report cold and warm separately.

[glic] Respect initially_hidden for the no-webview guest contents

When kGlicContentsInitiallyHidden is enabled, the warming pool creates
GlicNoWebviewContentsManager with initially_hidden=true so the guest
warms in the background without being treated as visible. That flag was
being ignored in two places.

First, the guest lives in a PrivilegedWebContents, and
PrivilegedWebContents::Create() had no way to pass initially_hidden
through, so the guest WebContents was always created visible.

Second, ApplySizeToGuest() unconditionally marked the guest visible. It
runs on guest navigation, including while warming or attached but
hidden, so even a hidden guest got flipped to visible on its first load.

This CL adds an optional PwcCreateOptions argument (with
initially_hidden) to PrivilegedWebContents::Create() and has the manager
pass it through. ApplySizeToGuest() now only marks the guest visible
when Glic itself is visible.

The loading/error overlay is left as is: it is only created once Glic is
visible, so it never needs to start hidden.

Tests cover PWC creation visibility and the manager keeping the guest
hidden through a navigation until Glic is shown.

PrivateAi: Add certificate_util with PemToDer helpers

Add PemToDer and PemToDerChain utility functions using BoringSSL's PEM
tokenizer to decode PEM-formatted X.509 certificates to DER bytes for
Private AI TLS sessions. PemToDerChain decodes every CERTIFICATE block
in order (leaf first), which is needed for OakCT certificate bundles
that ship the leaf together with its intermediates.

[Extensions] Fix UAF error in side panel during window/activity teardown

During activity teardown on Desktop Android (and window teardown on
Desktop), ExtensionSidePanelManager is destroyed before
SidePanelRegistry due to feature registration order. Previously,
ExtensionSidePanelCoordinator did not deregister its entry in its
destructor, leaving the SidePanelEntry and its cached native view in the
registry after the coordinator and its owned ExtensionViewHost were
destroyed.

When SidePanelRegistry was later destroyed, the cached view
(ExtensionSidePanelContentsAndroid) dereferenced the dangling
ExtensionViewHost pointer during host_->set_view(nullptr), causing a
Use-After-Free error.

This CL addresses the issue by:
- ExtensionSidePanelCoordinator now automatically calls DeregisterEntry() in its destructor so entries do not outlive their coordinator.
- ExtensionSidePanelContentsAndroid implements ExtensionHostObserver to observe the host and reset host_ to nullptr if the host is destroyed earlier, and guards host_->set_view(nullptr) with a null check.
- ExtensionSidePanelManagerBridge explicitly resets extension_side_panel_manager_ in its destructor prior to tearing down the JNI bridge.
- Adds a browser regression test verifying clean window teardown with an open extension side panel.

[Autofill] Stop caching scan card check result

It's possible for the scan card condition to change after the scan card chip is shown for the first time. Clicking the chip after the condition changed currently causes a crash, though another in-flight change is changing this so it does nothing. The easiest way to replicate this is to disable the camera permission for GMS Core.

NTP footer appears blank and doesn't paint until the web view is loaded.

[ChroMenu GlowUp] Let action menu items keep mnemonic text.

A MenuItemView bound to an ActionItem resets its title to
ActionItem::GetText() whenever the action changes. For menus built from
actions, this means:

- The items get no mnemonic. GetText() has no "&" marker, because
  other surfaces such as buttons and tooltips would draw it literally.
- A title set with SetTitle() is lost on the next action change, e.g.
  when the action is enabled or disabled.

This CL:
- Lets ActionItem text keep its mnemonic marker, like "&Find". Use
  "&&" for a literal "&". GetText() now returns the text without the
  marker, so buttons and tooltips are not affected.
- Adds ActionItem::GetTextWithMnemonic(), which returns the text as
  set. Action-bound menu items show it instead of GetText().
- Fixes MenuItemView::GetMnemonic() for "&&", which shows a literal
  "&". It returned the next character, like 't' for "AT&&T".

Nothing sets either hook yet, so there is no behavior change. CL 8536615
uses both (follow up CL).

DISABLE_SPELLCHECKER

[WebApps] Allow fallback to min-size and unsized favicons in InstallableIconFetcher

Currently, IsCandidateBigEnough() in InstallableIconFetcher only accepts
favicon candidates that explicitly meet ideal_size (or are SVGs/touch
icons) and rejects unsized kFavicon candidates and default /favicon.ico
entries. This prevents manifestless sites that only provide a
multi-resolution /favicon.ico (such as 48x48 .ico files) or icons sized
between min_size (48px) and ideal_size from using their favicon during
installation.

Update FetchFaviconFromCandidates() to use a two-pass selection:
1. Prefer candidates known to meet ideal_size (including SVGs,
   sizes="any", and touch icons).
2. If none match, fall back to candidates meeting min_size or unsized
   favicons (including default /favicon.ico), letting
   ManifestIconDownloader verify that the decoded bitmap meets min_size.

CSSRule::parent_ is set only via SetParentRule() and
SetParentStyleSheet(), which keep parent_is_rule_ in sync with the

only remaining caller of WrapperTypeInfo::IsSubclass(); inline the
parent_class walk there and remove WrapperTypeInfo::IsSubclass().

[CALI] View Tree: Show View Info on Hover

This CL adds View Info UI, which shows basic info of a View on hover.
Specifically, in the View Tree, when a View Row gets pointer hover, its
background gains a blue highlight, and the Info Bar shows the View's:
* Java Class.
* Dimensions in PX.
* Dimensions in DP.

To prepare for planned features (multi-select; same UI on Screenshot),
this CL implements hover UI in a structured fashion:
* Add `ViewEngaged` (owned by `MainModel`) as source of truth, storing
  nullable `hover` (upcoming: `sels` for selections).
* `TreeVis`'s hover handling:
  * Interface: `setHover()` to assign / sync hover value.
  * Interface: `withTransaction()` to wrap View Tree changes in order to
    transact (i.e., hide - update - show) visuals (i.e., hover).
  * Internal: `hoverIndex` to reduce churn and for transactions (e.g.,
    remember which rendered UI highlight to clear).
* Centralized event dispatching for hover: Currently hover is only
  triggered and shown on the View Tree. To prepare for Screenshot
  inclusion, this CL uses `MainController` (with injected callback) as
  an intermediary dispatcher; thus hover-related event handling is:

  [Event trigger]        --> [Dispatcher]   -->  [UI change]
  TreeController             MainController      TreeController
  (ScreenshotController)                         (ScreenshotController)

  * Inside `MainController`, also update model hover state and
    View Info.

Additional code improvements: Add CTOR JSDoc; use CSS `contain` to
prevent layout spillover; refactor `ViewNode` parsing; update UI / state
clearing.

Details:
* index.html: `#div-info-bar`: Add `.view-info` that shows details about
  a View, to be shown when its View Row is hovered by the pointer:
  * Add `.view-class` for the View's Java Class.
  * Add `.view-dims` for the View's dimensions, dynamically shown as
    "{W}x{H}px | {W}x{H}dp", using added `.size-px` and `.size-dp`.
* style.css:
  * `:root`: Add `--bg-hover` for hover highlight (translucent blue).
  * Optimization: Add `contain: (value)` to dynamic containers so their
    layout invalidations are isolated and do not bubble out:
    * `strict`: `#div-screenshot-info`, `#div-info-bar`: These
      containers' sizes don't depend on content.
    * `content`: `#div-view-tree`: This stretches via `flex-grow: 1`.
  * `#div-view-tree .view-row`: Add `&.hovered-view` to style highlight.
  * `#div-info-bar`:
    * Add `white-space: nowrap` to prevent wrapping.
    * Add `.view-info` as flex column.
      * Add `.view-class` to use bold.
      * Add `.view-dims` as row Flexbox in light blue text.
        * Add `.size-dp` to use bold.
    * `.view-class` and `.hint-text`: Add ellipses if overflow.
* math.js: Add `Rectangle`: Axis-aligned rectangle represented by
  top-left and bottom-right corners.
  * CTOR: Store passed `topLeft`, `bottomRight`.
  * Add static `fromComponents()` to instantiate from 4 coordinates.
  * Add `width()` and `height()`.
* model.js:
  * `ViewNode`:
    * CTOR: Add JSDoc; remove unused `xmlNode`; simplify to store passed
      params directly; add passed `rect`.
    * Add static `parseRect()` to extract XML bounds `[x1, y1][x2, y2]`
      to a `Rectangle`.
    * Add static `fromXml()` as factory method to instantiate from
      passed `xmlNode` and other properties. Parses `rect`, `className`,
      and `resourceId` before instantiating.
  * Add `ViewEngaged`: CTOR: Add `hover`. Add `clear()`.
  * `MainModel`: CTOR: Add `ViewEngaged engaged`.
    * `_populateViews()`: Change to use `ViewNode.fromXml()`.
    * `unload()`: Call `engaged.clear()`; reset `visOpts.{sDims,scale}`.
* ui_common.js:
  * Add JSDoc to CTORs: `InfoBarVis`, `HintController`, `DragHandler`,
    `OverlayVis`.
  * `InfoBarVis`:
    * CTOR: Cache `el.{viewInfo,viewClass,sizePx,sizeDp}`.
    * Add `renderAndShowViewInfo()`.
    * Add `hideViewInfo()`: Uses `.hidden` class.
  * `HINT_STRINGS[IDLE]`: Add instructions re. using hover to see info.
* screenshot_ui.js: JSDoc: Remove uninformative CTOR param comments.
* tree_ui.js:
  * `TreeVis`:
    * CTOR: Add JSDoc for params and nontrivial properties; add
      `hoverIndex`, initially `null`.
    * `clear()`: Resets `hoverIndex`.
    * Add `_renderHover()` to make CSS change to show / hide hover.
    * Add `withTransaction(fun)` to hide hover, call `fun()`, then
      re-enable hover (if it exists).
    * Add `setHover()` with idempotency guard to assign hover index,
      and update `hoverIndex` using `withTransaction()`.
  * `TreeController`:
    * CTOR: Add passed `onHover` callback.
    * Add `setHover()` for hover UI changes.
    * `_onToggleExpansion()`: Use `withTransaction()`.
    * `bindAll()`:
      * Add `getRowIndex()` to map `#div-view-tree` pointer event to
        the nearest `.view-row` if available, then extract the View
        index, while ignoring spurious events.
      * Handle `pointerover` and `pointerout`: Get index from
        `getRowIndex()` and dispatch to `onHover()`.
        * Optimization for `pointerout`: If `relatedTarget` is another
          `.view-row` then don't dispatch `null`, since `pointerover`
          will be triggered to take care of transition.
      * Update `click` handler to use `getRowIndex()`.
* app.js:
  * `MainVis`: CTOR: Add JSDoc.
    * Add `updateViewInfo()` to render / clear View Info depending on
      model `hover`.
    * Add `clear()` to hide View Info.
  * `MainController`:
    * CTOR: Add JSDoc; for `treeCtrl`, pass `onHover()`, which calls
      `handleHover()`.
    * `clearUI()`: Add Vis `clear()` call.
    * Add `handleHover()` with idempotency guard to set model `hover`,
      call `TreeController.setHover()`, and call Vis `updateViewInfo()`.

[SidePanel] Allow users to resize the side panel (1/3)

Implement the SideUiContainer manual resize contract for the side panel,
behind EnableAndroidSidePanelManualResizing.
-Previously, the side panel always used its automatic wide/narrow width
 and SideUiCoordinator showed no resize handle for it.
-Now, supportsManualResize() follows the flag, so SideUiResizeHandler
 shows the handle bar and the double arrow pointer icon. The handle
 matches the container's inner padding so it doesn't overlap the panel.
-A drag updates a transient width on every frame. Releasing it keeps
 the width, clamped between the minimum width and 500dp. A tap on the
 handle doesn't change the width.
-The picked width applies to all entries in the window until the window
 is destroyed. It isn't persisted, so each new session starts with the
 automatic width.
-A picked width overrides the automatic width. It is clamped to at least
 the minimum container width, and at most 500dp or the available width,
 whichever is smaller.
-Hiding the panel mid-drag drops the drag state, since the framework
 removes the handle without committing the drag.

[ImmersivePlayer] Postpone surface callbacks until dimensions are set

Previously, XrSurfaceEntityHolderImpl initialized surface dimensions to
1x1 and immediately fired surfaceCreated and surfaceChanged(1, 1) when a
callback was registered in addCallback(). When entering immersive video
playback while paused, CompositorViewImpl attached the surface with 1x1
bounds before the actual video dimensions were applied, causing the
initial frame to be rendered into a 1x1 buffer and stretched across the
entire player panel until playback resumed.

This change leaves mCurrentSurfaceDimensions unset until
setSurfacePixelDimensions(width, height) is called with valid dimensions
and defers surfaceCreated/surfaceChanged notifications until then. It
also applies pending video dimensions before immersive video options on
startup so custom mesh generators receive the actual surface dimensions.

Demo: https://screencast.googleplex.com/cast/NTc3NjA0Mjg5NDU1NzE4NHxiZjY3NzE2MS0xZQ

6db161d1f37dc0837f5ffdd4923a8f87827c98b4 [ diff ] 
DevTools: forward CorsURLLoader's Origin on intercepted redirects

InterceptionJob::ProcessFollowRedirect drops Origin from the headers it
forwards on a redirect (crrev.com/c/8150704), on the basis that the
network service recomputes it. Since crrev.com/c/8278433
(kAvoidCorsURLLoaderRestartOnRedirect), CorsURLLoader follows
cross-origin redirects in place and sets Origin itself, and nothing
recomputes it for a request that started without one. So with Fetch
interception enabled, a same-origin fetch redirected cross-origin
reaches the new origin without Origin.

Forward the Origin the caller passed to FollowRedirect unchanged. An
Origin recomputed by the interceptor or set by a client is still
dropped, as before.

R=caseq@chromium.org, toyoshim@chromium.org

[MultiColumn Settings] Remove the feature flag (reland)

Relanding the CL after fixing the issues that caused revert:

- Disabled SETTINGS_IN_TAB on 8 test suites that previously relied on
  @DisableFeatures(ChromeFeatureList.SETTINGS_MULTI_COLUMN) to
  implicitly disable SettingsInTab on tablets.
- Guarded fragment cast in ClearBrowsingDataFragmentTest
- Disambiguated two-column title matcher in SafetyHubTest.java

Original CL description:

Removes the feature flags kSettingsMultiColumn, kSettingsSingleActivity
after launch.

Many tests needed updating as they were expecting a certain View (having
a specific text or id) to be unique in the layout, but the assumption
doesn't hold true any more with multi-column enabled, since the new
layout has 2 recyclers views (header + detail pane). They were updated
to give more specific conditions to correctly identify the View they
needed.

Some Robolectric tests (SettingsActivityUnitTest,
AutofillServerCardEditorTest) that need to deal with SlidingPaneLayout,
and sign-out snackbar tests in MainSettingsFragmentTest are temporarily
disabled with a TODO to fix in follow-ups.

NO_IFTTT=Updated as expected

🌺 Revert "Batch PrintingControllerTest"

This reverts commit c738aefd960e9ca5495440394b37dd1f1aa9b7db.
Culprit: c738aefd960e - "Batch PrintingControllerTest" (refs/heads/main@{#1713365}, https://crrev.com/c/8518792)

Reason for revert: consistently fails android-arm-tests.

Mechanism: Batching PrintingControllerTest causes
PrintingControllerTest#testTabPrinterCanPrintHiddenTab to fail its
initial batched run in 34/34 consecutive builds on android-arm-tests
(#40362..#40395: 3 hard failures and 22 flaky runs in the last 25
builds) with AssertionError: currentTab should not be hidden.

PrintingControllerTest#testTabPrinterCanPrintHiddenTab has failed in
3/25 recent builds of android-arm-tests, every attempt in every one of
them. This is not flake: it reproduces on every run, so it blocks the CQ
for every unrelated CL that touches this suite. The regression appears
at refs/heads/main@{#1713365}.

Example failing run:
https://ci.chromium.org/ui/p/chrome/builders/ci/android-arm-tests/40395

To run/deflake this test on CQ before relanding, add the following
footer to your CL description:
  Include-Ci-Only-Tests: official.chrome.continuous:android-arm-tests|chrome_public_test_apk

Reverting to green the tree first. Please re-land once the failure is
understood and covered; this revert is about restoring CQ throughput,
not about the merit of the change.

Original change's description:
> Batch PrintingControllerTest
>
> Enables `@Batch(Batch.PER_CLASS)` on `PrintingControllerTest` to run all
> test cases within a single browser instrumentation instance, reducing
> emulator test execution time.
>
> * Adds `@Batch(Batch.PER_CLASS)` annotation.
> * Verified that per-window `PrintingControllerImpl` instances, transit
>   rules, and test state cleanly reset across tests.
>

[ash] Scope more test-only //chrome DEPS allowances to their tests

Forty-one more directories where a +chrome allowance is only ever used
by tests. Each such entry moves from include_rules into
specific_include_rules, keyed on the test files that actually need it,
so production code in these directories can no longer pick the
dependency up by accident.

Only directories that had no specific_include_rules block yet are
touched, so no existing key changes meaning.

Whole-tree checkdeps passes. As a control, adding one of the scoped
includes to a production file now fails with "Illegal include ...
Because of -chrome".

[BottomSheetTypes] Migrate GlicPromoSheetContent to BottomSheetType

Migrates GlicPromoSheetContent in GlicPromoCoordinator from the legacy
ContentPriority system to the decomposed BottomSheetType architecture.
Since this promo is triggered passively on browser startup when eligible
via feature engagement (rather than an explicit user action), it is
configured as PASSIVE_PROMO (isUserInitiated = false, isModal = true,
isPersistent = false, isUserCritical = NONE) using a static
BOTTOM_SHEET_TYPE constant.

[iOS][Actor] Reuse one ToolController per ActorEngine

Completing an action started the next one synchronously, which replaced
the ToolController while its CompleteToolRequest() was still running.

Match Desktop: create the controller once, post all completion
callbacks to the engine, and scope per-tool state (observation delay,
weak pointers) to each tool. Cancel() drops results that are posted but
not yet delivered, and starting a tool CHECKs that the controller is
idle. Destroying the controller cancels the active tool.

[webauthn] Filter algorithms sent to security keys

The FIDO conformance tool did not properly test how security keys handle
unknown COSE algorithm identifiers in makeCredential requests, so some
keys may fail once relying parties start requesting post-quantum
algorithms.

When an authenticator advertises its supported algorithms in its getInfo
response, only send it the requested algorithms that it supports,
preserving the relying party's order.

This is behind the WebAuthnFilterAlgorithmsForAuthenticator feature,
enabled by default.

footer(s) to your CL description:

This is mitigation, not a fix. The bug tracks the real investigation and
is assigned to the owning team.

[chromecast] Remove ExternalAudioPipelineShlib and MixerOutputStream

ExternalAudioPipelineShlib let an OEM library take over audio output
from the Cast audio mixer, and MixerOutputStream was the mixer's output
sink interface. Both were only consumed by the mixer, which was deleted
in crrev.com/c/7842564 ("chromecast: Delete mixer service receiver and
CMA backend").

What remained were a no-op implementation packaged as
libcast_external_audio_pipeline_1.0, a fake and a sample implementation
(the sample was not in any build target), and a desktop
MixerOutputStream target with no dependents. Remove all of them.

[chromecast] Remove unused ALSA CMA backend

chromecast/media/cma/backend/alsa held ALSA implementations of the
system volume control and of MixerOutputStream for the Cast audio mixer.
The mixer was deleted in crrev.com/c/7842564 ("chromecast: Delete mixer
service receiver and CMA backend"), and since then the only reference to
the directory was its own unittests, which were added to
cast_media_unittests on use_alsa builds.

Remove the directory, its unittests hook, its inclusive-language
exemption, and the --alsa-* switches that only it read.

[WebAudio] Report TypeError for non-callable process (Part 2 of 2)

AudioWorkletProcessor::Process() previously collapsed a throwing
process getter and a non-callable process property into a generic
"process() method undefined." message with zeroed source location.

Split the two failure branches:
- When Get(processor, "process") throws, populate kProcessError with
  the exception message and location from v8::TryCatch via
  AudioWorkletProcessor::ErrorDetailsFromTryCatch().
- When process is not callable, report kProcessMethodUndefinedError
  with "TypeError: <name> process() method is not callable."

Remove the WPT failure baseline now that all subtests pass.

[FedCM] Check current sheet content in AccountSelectionMediator observer

As part of deferring bottom sheet content swap on HIDDEN,
BottomSheetController retains the outgoing sheet as the current sheet
while dispatching onSheetStateChanged(SheetState.HIDDEN).

Previously, AccountSelectionMediator tracked mLastSheetSeen in
onSheetContentChanged because BottomSheetController cleared current
content to null before firing onSheetStateChanged(HIDDEN). With
deferred content swap enabled, AccountSelectionMediator can directly
check mBottomSheetController.getCurrentSheetContent() ==
mBottomSheetContent. When the feature flag is disabled, it falls back
to mLastSheetSeen as before.

[Android] Inline ViewUtils.waitForView() to ViewFinder

ViewUtils.waitForView(ViewGroup root, Matcher<View> viewMatcher) was a
thin wrapper around ViewFinder.waitForView(allOf(..., isDescendantOfA(is(root)))).

Migrate all callers directly to ViewFinder.waitForView():

  SeamlessSigninTest, AccessorySheetRenderTest, and BookmarkTest, the
  views have unique IDs in their window and don't need root scoping.
- Drop redundant isDisplayed() matchers and (ViewGroup) casts.

  waitForViewOnActivityRoot() in ManualFillingTestHelper.
- Remove ViewUtils.waitForView() from ViewUtils.java.

[chromecast] Remove unread command-line switches

Remove switches from chromecast_switches.{h,cc} that nothing in the
tree reads, either by their C++ identifier or by their literal flag
string:

  * kAcceptResourceProvider
  * kAlsaCheckCloseTimeout, kAlsaEnableUpsampling,
    kAlsaFixedOutputSampleRate
  * kAudioOutputSampleRate, kMaxOutputVolumeDba1m
  * kDisableCrashpadForwarding
  * kMixerEnableDynamicChannelCount,
    kMixerSourceAudioReadyThresholdMs, kMixerSourceInputQueueMs
  * kMixerServiceEndpoint, kMixerServicePort

Most of these configured the StreamMixer and the mixer service, which
were deleted earlier. The mixer-service flags were still passed to
cast_audio_backend_unittests, but that target now contains only
volume_map_unittest.cc, which does not bind a mixer service. Drop that
filter, and drop the stale MixerServiceWrapper forward declaration in
CastAudioOutputStream.

[Autofill] Guard wallet reminder sheet close on current content

AutofillWalletReminderNoticeBottomSheetMediator registers itself as a
BottomSheetObserver before calling requestShowContent(). If the sheet
is queued behind an existing sheet or preempts a lower-priority sheet,
onSheetClosed() is notified when the previous sheet finishes hiding.
When BottomSheetFeatureMap.sBottomSheetDeferContentSwapOnHidden is
enabled, check that mBottomSheetController.getCurrentSheetContent()
matches mBottomSheetContent before recording dismissal metrics and
destroying the mediator, which hides the content and removes the
observer.

62cbbced8b4750e1d70c7e20621e63287dc295b2 [ diff ] 
[CRD Linux] Implement createRemoteUserSessions

When `createRemoteUserSessions` is set in session_routing.json and the
resolved user has no graphical session, UserDesktopSessionBackend now
asks GdmRemoteUserDesktopSessionCreator to create a remote session for
the user, waits for logind to report it, and attaches to it. If other
RemoteUserDesktopSessionCreator implementations are added (e.g. for a
future XDG API), the backend can select one, with GDM as the fallback.

- Since the session is created without interactive authentication,
  the host first checks that the username is the canonical passwd
  name, and rejects root and system accounts, users whose login shell
  isn't listed in /etc/shells, and users that PAM doesn't allow to log
  in.
- Session creators may report success before the session starts, and
  don't report later failures (e.g. PAM rejecting the login), so the
  connection is rejected if no session shows up within 30 seconds.
- While waiting, the host looks up the user's sessions again on each
  logind SessionNew signal.
- Created sessions are not terminated when the client disconnects or
  the host stops, and are re-adopted by the next connection.

Unit tests cover the eligibility checks. The creation flow isn't unit
tested since there are no fakes for LoginSessionManager or
DesktopSessionLinux. Manually tested on GDM 50.3 with an earlier
version of GDM !406 (PAM service then named gdm-user-display):
https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gdm/-/merge_requests/406

[Android] Stop retrying back press in leaveHubToPreviousTabViaBack()

The retry was added in crrev.com/c/5574005 without a stated reason. It
is unsafe: withRetry() presses back again if the transition hasn't
finished within the timeout. If the Hub already left but a destination
Condition was slow, the second press goes to the page instead, which
can close the tab or finish the Activity.

The retry was never exercised in practice: across 1,965 back presses
from the tab switcher in 126 recent builds on 21 Android CI builders,
no "try #1 failed" was logged.

TabUiTestHelper#leaveTabSwitcher() avoided the retry by building its
own back press trip. It now uses leaveHubToPreviousTabViaBack().

[Reading Mode] Add refactor browser tests for the page handler.

Some page handler browser tests were previously disabled with
kReadAnythingDistillerRefactor because they depend on the legacy path:
the browser starting Readability distillation and sending UpdateContent.
With the refactor, the renderer requests distillation instead, and the
renderer is mocked in these tests.

ReadAnythingUntrustedPageHandlerDistillerTest was added when Readability
was introduced. Now that Readability has launched, it is enabled in
every fixture, so this fixture no longer adds coverage beyond
ReadAnythingUntrustedPageHandlerTest.

This CL moves the flag-agnostic tests into
ReadAnythingUntrustedPageHandlerTest and keeps only the tests that need
the legacy path in ReadAnythingUntrustedPageHandlerDistillerTest. It
then adds refactor versions of those tests to
ReadAnythingUntrustedPageHandlerDistillerRefactorTest and
ReadAnythingUntrustedPageHandlerDistillerRefactorAutomationTest. These
tests call RequestReadabilityDistillation() directly to stand in for the
renderer, because the distiller interface is not mocked.

remoting: Fix window dragging on macOS 27 using CGEventPost

On macOS 27, windows can't be dragged in a CRD session. The deprecated
CGPostMouseEvent API doesn't keep kCGMouseEventNumber the same across a
mouse-down, drag and mouse-up sequence, so macOS doesn't treat it as a
single drag.

On macOS 27 and later, mouse events are now injected with
CGEventCreateMouseEvent and CGEventPost:
- Every event from button-down to button-up uses the same event number.
- Movement while a button is held is sent as a ...MouseDragged event.
- kCGMouseEventClickState is tracked, so double and triple clicks work.
- Mouse events carry the modifier keys currently held.

Events are posted to kCGSessionEventTap, matching the existing keyboard
and scroll-wheel injection in the same file.

Earlier macOS versions keep the existing CGPostMouseEvent path.

Testing: remoting_unittests passes, including 6 new InputInjectorMacTest
tests. Tested by hand on macOS 26.7.1 in a curtained session, with the
new path temporarily forced on. Window dragging, double and triple
click, right click, Shift-click, Cmd-click, scrolling and Finder drag
and drop all work.

[Passwords] Guard AllPasswordsBottomSheetView dismiss on current content

AllPasswordsBottomSheetView registers its BottomSheetObserver before
calling requestShowContent(). When it preempts a currently visible
lower-priority sheet (or is queued while another sheet hides), the
outgoing sheet triggers onSheetClosed() and
onSheetStateChanged(SheetState.HIDDEN) while
getCurrentSheetContent() still points to the outgoing sheet.

Extract onDismissed(), which both callbacks share, and when
BottomSheetFeatureMap.sBottomSheetDeferContentSwapOnHidden is enabled,
guard it on mBottomSheetController.getCurrentSheetContent() ==
AllPasswordsBottomSheetView.this so preempting another sheet does not
prematurely dismiss AllPasswordsBottomSheetView or unregister its
observer.

ActorProfileAgent, which bridges
BackgroundContinuedProcessingTaskProviders asked on background entry.

ActorServiceFactory gains GetForProfileIfExists() so the agent never
creates the service.

label when it is selected`) failed when checking that `notifications` is
empty before `await paintFinished()`.

`handleKeyNavigation()` awaits `this.updateComplete` (a microtask) and
then synchronously calls `updateInputForSelection()`, which calls
`setSelectionA11yLabel()` and schedules `afterNextPaint()`
(`requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(callback, 0))`).

The tests previously called `await microtasksFinished()` after
dispatching the key event. Despite its name, `microtasksFinished()` uses
`setTimeout(..., 0)` (a macrotask). Because earlier `setTimeout` calls
in the test suite have already pushed `DOMTimer`'s nesting level past
`kSpecCompliantMaxTimerNestingLevel` (5), `microtasksFinished()`'s timer
is clamped to 4ms (`TaskType::kJavascriptTimerDelayedHighNesting`).
Meanwhile, if `requestAnimationFrame` fires within that 4ms window, its
nested `setTimeout(callback, 0)` runs with a reset timer nesting level
(0ms delay, `TaskType::kJavascriptTimerImmediate`), causing the deferred
`ariaNotify` announcement to fire before `microtasksFinished()`
resolves.

Await `element.updateComplete` instead of `microtasksFinished()` after
dispatching the key events so the pre-paint assertions run in the
microtask checkpoint before any animation frame or timer macrotask can
fire.

🌺 Fix StartupPaintPreviewHelperTest#testCaptureOnBackgrounded on Desktop

StartupPaintPreviewHelperTest#testCaptureOnBackgrounded has been
consistently failing (15/25 builds) on
android-desktop-17-x64-rel-brya-tests with TimeoutException waiting for
the paint preview capture after UiDevice.pressHome().

Root cause: UiDevice.pressHome() injects KEYCODE_HOME, which does not
stop or background freeform windows on Android Desktop, so the onStop
paint preview capture never triggers.

Use ChromeApplicationTestUtils.fireHomeScreenIntent() instead of
UiDevice.pressHome() (matching SessionMetricsTest and
StartupLoadingMetricsTest).

Example failing build:
https://ci.chromium.org/ui/p/chrome/builders/ci/android-desktop-17-x64-rel-brya-tests/1824

[glic] Enable actor navigation-away throttle checks on desktop Android

• Enable speculative prerender cancellation, Back/Forward history
  skips and the omnibox FROM_ADDRESS_BAR check on Android in
  ActorNavigationThrottle.

• Unify MaybeDeferNavigation across platforms by having
  ActorUiTabControllerInterface extend the throttle delegate,
  validating on Android that the tab matches &*tab_.

• Route CancelNavigationConfirmation through
  ActorUiTabControllerInterface the same way, so ActorUiStateManager
  needs no platform fork. ActorUiTabController now overrides the
  delegate method that takes the tab.

• Set the navigation delegate in ActorKeyedService::CreateTask on
  all platforms so desktop Android prompts the user before leaving
  an active task.

• Gate MaybeDeferNavigation on the task being active on the tab so
  paused tasks proceed without prompting, matching Desktop.

• Destroy the JNI callback in ActorUiTabController.maybeDeferNavigation
  when no dialog is shown.

• Update ActorNavigationThrottleTest with tests for CreateTask
  delegate routing, paused tasks, same-URL cancel routing and phones,
  and run the FROM_ADDRESS_BAR tests on desktop Android.

• Add ActorUiTabControllerAndroid test suppression hook and use it
  in ActorToolsTest.

[ttc][android] Add app-menu entry point and floating session pill

Gives Chrome for Android a way to start a TTC session and see that one
is running, on top of the Java TtcKeyedService bridge:

- App menu: a "TTC" item next to the Glic item, shown when the flag is
  on and the service is available. Selecting it toggles a session.
- TtcSessionMediator: follows the active profile, requests RECORD_AUDIO
  if needed, starts / ends the session and ends it in onStopWithNative.
- TtcSessionCoordinator (owned by TabbedRootUiCoordinator) only wires
  the mediator's model to the pill.
- Session pill: an AnchoredPopupWindow pinned to the bottom-end corner
  of the content area, built on first show via
  LazyConstructionPropertyMcp and bound with a PropertyModel. Shows
  connecting / listening / error and ends the session on tap. Nothing
  is added to main.xml.

Every form factor gets this small-screen UI for now; both the pill and
the menu item branch on TtcSessionCoordinator.usesMobileSessionUi(),
which is the single switch for a large-screen presentation
(b/571214745). The mediator itself is form-factor agnostic.

First cut: the session ends when Chrome is backgrounded, the pill uses
a fixed bottom margin, and the strings aren't translateable. Everything
is inert when the Ttc flag is off.

Screenshot: https://screenshot.googleplex.com/34pfUPiNm3KeNdy

Binary-Size: First Java caller of the TtcKeyedService JNI bridge, so the
  linker stops discarding the existing TTC session stack it reaches. No
  new native code; all flag-gated behind Ttc.

[WebAuthn] Guard incognito confirmation sheet close on current content

When the AuthenticatorIncognitoConfirmationBottomsheet is preempted
or queued while another BottomSheetContent finishes hiding, its
BottomSheetObserver receives onSheetStateChanged(SheetState.HIDDEN)
for the outgoing sheet. Check that mController.getCurrentSheetContent()
matches mBottomSheetContent before closing the incognito confirmation
sheet.

The check relies on the hidden content staying the current content
while observers are notified, which is only the case when
BottomSheetFeatureMap.sBottomSheetDeferContentSwapOnHidden is enabled.
Without it, the controller has already replaced the content, so skip the
check and close on any HIDDEN state as before.

Also close the sheet, which runs the negative callback, when the
controller destroys a content that is not the current one, e.g. when it
is cleared from the show requests: it never observes HIDDEN. Mark the
sheet as closed before hiding the content, since hiding can destroy the
content right away, which would close the sheet a second time and run
the callbacks twice. Gate both changes on
BottomSheetFeatureMap.sBottomSheetDeferContentSwapOnHidden as well.

[ROSP] Add startup policy and URLs count metrics

Records Android-specific histograms for the evaluated session startup
policy and configured startup URLs count on cold startup. Using a
dedicated Android startup policy histogram preserves an explicit bucket
for unset preferences until Clank supports local on-startup settings.

* Records the Android.MultiWindow.StartupPolicy enumerated histogram
  when claiming the session startup policy for a regular window.
* Records the Android.MultiWindow.RestoreOnStartupUrlsCount count
  histogram when resolving configured startup URLs for a regular window.

[iOS][Actor] End background task when actor task waits on user or pauses

ActorTask now completes its background continued processing task when
entering a state that can last indefinitely (waiting on the user or
paused), so that the system doesn't expire the task for lack of
progress. The policy is an exhaustive switch so that new states require
an explicit decision.

Unsupported interrupt reasons briefly enter kWaitingOnUser before
stopping, so their background task is reported as successful. This is
addressed once those interrupts are supported.
